1.

"Man of Sorrows!" O what a name For the Son of God, who went here before! What a Saviour, God's Lamb! Hallelujah, He is worthy!

2.

Here He stood in our place And bought us with His blood. As our Saviour He died. Hallelujah, He is worthy!

3.

We bore the burden of sin, The Lamb without blemish He was. What a Saviour we have! Hallelujah, He is worthy!

4.

He bore the cross's shame and woe, The work there He perfected. The Saviour we see exalted. Hallelujah, He is worthy!

5.

Lord He is on the throne, And we worship Him there. What a Saviour He is! Hallelujah, He is worthy!
